source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice mcqs written from Chapter 1 (PDF 4-35), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 1 (Biodiversity and Classification) ke poore chapter se practice MCQs hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein. Har sawal ka aik sahi jawab hai aur saath mukhtasar wajah; numerical sawalon mein hal ke qadam diye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt:
1 The five-kingdom system of classification was proposed in 1969 by:
(Five-kingdom classification system 1969 mein kis ne pesh kiya?)
blocks.explanation: American ecologist Robert Whittaker ne 1969 mein five-kingdom system pesh kiya (1.1).

book_ref.quote: proposed by American ecologists Robert Whittaker in 1969

blocks.prompt:
2 In the five-kingdom system, the prokaryotes were placed in kingdom:
(Five-kingdom system mein prokaryotes ko kis kingdom mein rakha gaya tha?)
blocks.explanation: Five-kingdom system mein kingdom Monera mein prokaryotes thay; baqi chaar kingdoms mein eukaryotes thay (1.1).

book_ref.quote: the kingdom Monera included prokaryotes while all the other four kingdoms included eukaryotes

blocks.prompt:
3 The three-domain system was suggested by Carl Woese in the year:
(Carl Woese ne three-domain system kis saal pesh kiya?)
blocks.explanation: 1990 mein Carl Woese ne prokaryotes ke do alag groups batay aur zindagi ko teen domains mein taqseem kiya (1.1).

book_ref.quote: In 1990, American microbiologist Carl Woese suggested

blocks.prompt:
4 The evolutionary relationship among organisms is called:
(Organisms ke darmiyan evolutionary rishte ko kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Organisms ka evolutionary rishta phylogeny (nasli taalluq) kehlata hai; is ka diagram phylogenetic ya evolutionary tree hai (1.1).

book_ref.quote: The evolutionary relationship among organisms is called phylogeny

blocks.prompt:
5 According to molecular evidence, archaea are more closely related to:
(Molecular saboot ke mutabiq archaea kis ke zyada qareeb hain?)
blocks.explanation: Molecular saboot batata hai ke archaea bacteria ke bajaye eukaryotes ke zyada qareeb hain; Eukarya Archaea se bane (1.1).

book_ref.quote: Molecular evidence suggests that archaea are more closely related to eukaryotes than to bacteria

blocks.prompt:
6 The Greek word archaios, from which the name Archaea comes, means:
(Yunani lafz archaios, jis se Archaea ka naam aaya, ka matlab hai:)
blocks.explanation: Archaea Yunani lafz archaios se hai jis ka matlab 'qadeem' (purana) hai (Domain Archaea).

book_ref.quote: The name Archaea comes from the Greek archaios

blocks.prompt:
7 Aggregates or filaments formed by some archaeans may reach a length of up to:
(Kuch archaeans ke aggregates ya filaments ki lambai kitni tak ho sakti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Akele archaeans 0.1 μm se 15 μm se zyada tak hote hain; kuch 200 μm tak lambe aggregates ya filaments banate hain (Domain Archaea).

book_ref.quote: Some form aggregates or filaments up to 200 μm in length

blocks.prompt:
8 Which of the following does NOT occur in archaea?
(In mein se kaun sa amal archaea mein nahi hota?)
blocks.explanation: Archaea binary ya multiple fission, fragmentation ya budding se asexual reproduction karte hain; mitosis aur meiosis nahi hote (Domain Archaea).

book_ref.quote: Mitosis and meiosis do not occur in archaea

blocks.prompt:
9 In the membrane lipids of archaea, glycerol is joined to the fatty acid chains by:
(Archaea ki membrane lipids mein glycerol fatty acid chains se kis bond se juda hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Archaea ki membrane lipids mein glycerol aur branched fatty acid chains ke darmiyan ether linkage hai; bacteria aur Eukarya mein ester linkage hai (Domain Archaea).

book_ref.quote: Their cell membrane contains lipids with ether-linkage between glycerol and fatty acid chains

blocks.prompt:
10 Archaeal cell membranes are more resistant to extreme conditions because their fatty acid chains are:
(Archaea ki cell membrane intehai halaat mein zyada mazboot kyun hai? Un ki fatty acid chains hoti hain:)
blocks.explanation: Archaea mein fatty acid chains branched aur ether-linked hain, is liye membrane intehai halaat mein zyada mazboot hai (Domain Archaea).

book_ref.quote: The fatty acid chains are branched

blocks.prompt:
11 The cell walls of some archaea contain:
(Kuch archaea ki cell wall mein kya hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Archaea ki cell wall mein cellulose aur peptidoglycan nahi hote; un mein khaas polysaccharides aur proteins hain, aur kuch mein pseudopeptidoglycan hai (Domain Archaea).

book_ref.quote: Some archaea have pseudopeptidoglycan

blocks.prompt:
12 Which metabolic process is found only in archaea and not in bacteria or Eukarya?
(Kaun sa metabolic amal sirf archaea mein hai, bacteria ya Eukarya mein nahi?)
blocks.explanation: Methanogenesis (methane banana) archaea ka khaas amal hai jo bacteria ya Eukarya mein nahi milta (Domain Archaea).

book_ref.quote: Archaea have unique metabolic processes like methanogenesis

blocks.prompt:
13 The group of archaea that lives in extremely saline environments is:
(Archaea ka kaun sa group bohat namkeen mahol mein rehta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Halobacteria bohat namkeen mahol mein rehte hain; Thermococci garam jagahon mein; Thaumarchaeota nitrogen cycle mein (Domain Archaea).

book_ref.quote: Halobacteria (live in extremely saline environments)

blocks.prompt:
14 Which group of archaea is involved in the nitrogen cycle?
(Archaea ka kaun sa group nitrogen cycle mein hissa leta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Thaumarchaeota woh archaea hain jo nitrogen cycle mein shamil hain (Domain Archaea).

book_ref.quote: Thaumarchaeota (involved in nitrogen cycle)

blocks.prompt:
15 In humans, intestinal gas is largely the result of the metabolism of:
(Insaan mein aanton ki gas zyada tar kis ke metabolism ka nateeja hai?)
blocks.explanation: Insaan mein aanton ki gas zyada tar methanogen archaea ke metabolism se banti hai (Domain Archaea).

book_ref.quote: intestinal gas is largely the result of the metabolism of methanogens

blocks.prompt:
16 Archaea used to extract metals such as gold, cobalt and copper from ores are the:
(Kachi dhaat se sona, cobalt aur copper nikalne ke liye kaun se Archaea istemal hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Acidophilic archaea mineral processing mein kachi dhaat se sona, cobalt aur copper nikalne ke kaam aate hain (Archaea ki ahmiyat).

book_ref.quote: Acidophillic Archaea are used to extract metals such as gold, cobalt and copper from ores

blocks.prompt:
17 In sewage treatment, methanogen archaeans carry out anaerobic digestion and produce:
(Sewage treatment mein methanogen archaeans anaerobic digestion kar ke kya banate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Methanogen archaeans sewage treatment ka ahem hissa hain; yeh anaerobic digestion kar ke biogas banate hain (Archaea ki ahmiyat).

book_ref.quote: the methanogen archaeans are a vital part of sewage treatment

blocks.prompt:
18 The bacterial cell wall is composed of:
(Bacteria ki cell wall kis cheez se bani hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Bacteria ki cell wall peptidoglycan ki hoti hai, jo sugars aur amino acids ka polymer hai aur sahara aur shakal deta hai (Domain Bacteria).

book_ref.quote: Bacteria have a cell wall composed of peptidoglycan

blocks.prompt:
19 Small, circular DNA molecules of bacteria that can be transferred between bacteria are called:
(Bacteria ke chhote, gol DNA molecules jo aik bacterium se doosre mein ja sakte hain, kya kehlate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Plasmids chhote gol DNA molecules hain jo bacteria ke darmiyan muntaqil ho sakte hain aur genetic diversity barhate hain (Domain Bacteria).

book_ref.quote: Most bacteria have small, circular DNA molecules that can be transferred between bacteria

blocks.prompt:
20 Comma-shaped bacteria are called:
(Comma ki shakal wale bacteria ko kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Cocci gol, bacilli rod jaise, spirilla spiral aur vibrios comma jaise hote hain (Domain Bacteria).

book_ref.quote: spirilla (spiral-shaped), and vibrios (comma-shaped)

blocks.prompt:
21 Spherical bacteria arranged in clusters are called:
(Guchhon (clusters) mein lage gol bacteria ko kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Joron mein diplococci, zanjeer mein streptococci aur guchhon mein staphylococci (Domain Bacteria).

book_ref.quote: chains (streptococci), clusters (staphylococci)

blocks.prompt:
22 Hair-like structures that help bacteria attach to surfaces and exchange genetic material are:
(Baal jaise structures jo bacteria ko satah se chipakne aur genetic material ke tabadle mein madad dete hain:)
blocks.explanation: Pili aur fimbriae baal jaise structures hain jo chipakne aur genetic material ke tabadle ke kaam aate hain; flagella chabuk jaise hain aur harkat dete hain (Domain Bacteria).

book_ref.quote: They help in attachment to surfaces and in exchange of genetic material with other bacteria

blocks.prompt:
23 Bacteria that thrive in high salinity are called:
(Zyada namak mein panapne wale bacteria kya kehlate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Extremophile bacteria mein thermophiles (zyada temperature), halophiles (zyada namak) aur acidophiles (kam pH) shamil hain (Domain Bacteria).

book_ref.quote: high salinity (halophiles)

blocks.prompt:
24 Anabaena and Spirulina belong to the bacterial group:
(Anabaena aur Spirulina bacteria ke kis group se hain?)
blocks.explanation: Cyanobacteria mein Anabaena aur Spirulina shamil hain (Bacteria ke bare groups).

book_ref.quote: Cyanobacteria e.g., Anabaena, Spirulina

blocks.prompt:
25 Mycobacterium tuberculosis is placed in the group:
(Mycobacterium tuberculosis kis group mein hai?)
blocks.explanation: Actinobacteria mein Streptomyces aur Mycobacterium tuberculosis shamil hain (Bacteria ke bare groups).

book_ref.quote: Actinobacteria e.g., Streptomyces, Mycobacterium tuberculosis

blocks.prompt:
26 Treponema pallidum is an example of:
(Treponema pallidum kis ki misaal hai?)
blocks.explanation: Spirochaetes mein Treponema pallidum shamil hai (Bacteria ke bare groups).

book_ref.quote: Spirochaetes e.g., Treponema pallidum

blocks.prompt:
27 In eukaryotes, DNA is associated with proteins called:
(Eukaryotes mein DNA kin proteins ke saath juda hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Eukaryotes ka DNA kai linear chromosomes mein hota hai aur histone proteins ke saath juda hota hai (Domain Eukarya).

book_ref.quote: DNA is associated with histone proteins

blocks.prompt:
28 Eukaryotes are believed to have originated through:
(Khayal hai ke eukaryotes kis amal se wujood mein aaye?)
blocks.explanation: Eukaryotes ghaliban endosymbiosis se bane: prokaryotic cells (jaise mitochondria aur chloroplasts) ko aik host cell ne nigal liya (Domain Eukarya).

book_ref.quote: Eukaryotes are believed to have originated through endosymbiosis

blocks.prompt:
29 The network of microtubules, microfilaments and intermediate filaments in eukaryotic cells is the:
(Eukaryotic cells mein microtubules, microfilaments aur intermediate filaments ka jaal kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Cytoskeleton structural sahara deta hai, cell ki harkat aur cell ke andar transport mein madad karta hai (Domain Eukarya).

book_ref.quote: a complex network of microtubules, microfilaments, and intermediate filaments

blocks.prompt:
30 The highest level of biological classification is:
(Biological classification ka sab se ooncha darja kaun sa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Domain classification ka sab se ooncha darja hai; teen domains hain (1.2).

book_ref.quote: It is the highest level of classification

blocks.prompt:
31 Organisms that share a basic body plan and significant structural features are grouped in the same:
(Jin organisms ka bunyadi body plan aur ahem structural features aik jaise hon, woh aik hi ... mein hote hain:)
blocks.explanation: Phylum kingdom se neeche hai; is ke arkaan ka bunyadi body plan aur structural features aik jaise hote hain (1.2).

book_ref.quote: Organisms within a phylum share a basic body plan

blocks.prompt:
32 Humans, monkeys and apes, with large brains and opposable thumbs, are placed in the order:
(Insaan, bandar aur apes, jin ke bare dimagh aur opposable anguthe hain, kis order mein hain?)
blocks.explanation: Class Mammalia mein order Primates mein insaan, bandar aur apes shamil hain (1.2).

book_ref.quote: the order Primates includes humans, monkeys, and apes

blocks.prompt:
33 The family that includes great apes and humans is:
(Woh family jis mein great apes aur insaan shamil hain:)
blocks.explanation: Order Primates mein family Hominidae mein great apes aur insaan hain (1.2).

book_ref.quote: the family Hominidae includes great apes and humans

blocks.prompt:
34 The most specific level of classification, whose members can interbreed and produce fertile offspring, is:
(Classification ka sab se makhsoos darja jis ke arkaan aapas mein nasl barha kar zarkhez aulad paida kar saken:)
blocks.explanation: Species sab se makhsoos darja hai; is ke arkaan aapas mein nasl barha kar zarkhez aulad paida kar sakte hain (1.2).

book_ref.quote: Members of a species can interbreed and produce fertile offspring

blocks.prompt:
35 Each rank in the biological classification system is called a:
(Biological classification ke har darje ko kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Hierarchy ke darje taxa (wahid: taxon) kehlate hain, har aik classification ka aik rank hai (1.2).

book_ref.quote: known as taxa (singular: taxon)

blocks.prompt:
36 Very closely related, often visually similar species are grouped into a:
(Bohat qareebi rishtedar, aksar dekhne mein milti julti species ko kis mein rakha jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Genus family ke andar makhsoos rank hai jo bohat qareebi species ko jama karta hai, jaise Homo (1.2).

book_ref.quote: Genus is a more specific rank within a family

blocks.text: 1.3 Salient features of the kingdoms of domain Eukarya

blocks.prompt:
37 Protists are called 'simple multicellular' because they:
(Protists ko 'simple multicellular' kyun kaha jata hai?)

options.text: un mein multicellular sex organs nahi hote
un mein cell membrane nahi hoti

blocks.explanation: Simple multicellular ka matlab hai ke protists mein multicellular sex organs nahi hote (Kingdom Protista).

book_ref.quote: Simple multicellular means that they do not have multicellular sex organs

blocks.prompt:
38 Sleeping sickness is caused by the protist:
(Sleeping sickness kis protist se hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Plasmodium se malaria, Entamoeba histolytica se amoebic dysentery aur Trypanosoma se sleeping sickness hoti hai (Kingdom Protista).

book_ref.quote: sleeping sickness (Trypanosoma)

blocks.prompt:
39 Animal-like, unicellular, heterotrophic protists belong to the group:
(Janwar jaise, unicellular, heterotrophic protists kis group mein hain?)
blocks.explanation: Protozoa janwar jaise protists hain, unicellular aur heterotrophic, jaise Paramecium, Amoeba (Kingdom Protista).

book_ref.quote: The group Protozoa includes animal-like protists

blocks.prompt:
40 Slime molds and water molds are:
(Slime molds aur water molds kya hain?)
blocks.explanation: Myxomycota aur Oomycota fungi jaise protists hain, saprophytic, jaise slime molds aur water molds (Kingdom Protista).

book_ref.quote: The groups Myxomycota and Oomycota include Fungi-like protists

blocks.prompt:
41 The cell wall of fungi is made of:
(Fungi ki cell wall kis cheez ki hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Fungi ke cells ki cell wall chitin ki hoti hai, jo aik polysaccharide hai (Kingdom Fungi).

book_ref.quote: Their cells are covered by cell wall made of chitin

blocks.prompt:
42 Fungi obtain their food by:
(Fungi apni ghiza kaise hasil karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Fungi janwaron ki tarah khana nigalte nahi; woh mahol se khana jazb karte hain (Kingdom Fungi).

book_ref.quote: They absorb food from surroundings

blocks.prompt:
43 The approximate number of known species of fungi is:
(Fungi ki maloom species taqreeban kitni hain?)
blocks.explanation: Fungi ki taqreeban 100,000 maloom species hain (Kingdom Fungi).

book_ref.quote: There are about 100,000 known species of fungi

blocks.prompt:
44 Fungi whose hyphae lack septa, such as Rhizopus, belong to:
(Jin fungi ki hyphae mein septa nahi hote, jaise Rhizopus, woh kis group mein hain?)
blocks.explanation: Zygomycota ki hyphae mein septa nahi hote, jaise Rhizopus (bread mold) (Kingdom Fungi).

book_ref.quote: Zygomycota includes the fungi which lack septa in their hyphae

blocks.prompt:
45 Mushrooms, puffballs, rusts and smuts belong to:
(Mushrooms, puffballs, rusts aur smuts kis group mein hain?)
blocks.explanation: Basidiomycota ki hyphae septate hain; misalein mushrooms, toadstools, puffballs, jelly aur bracket fungi, rusts aur smuts (Kingdom Fungi).

book_ref.quote: Examples are mushrooms, toadstools, puffballs, jelly fungi

blocks.prompt:
46 Yeasts, morels and truffles are placed in:
(Yeasts, morels aur truffles kis group mein hain?)
blocks.explanation: Ascomycota fungi ka sab se bara group hai; is mein molds, morels, truffles, cup fungi, Neurospora aur yeasts hain (Kingdom Fungi).

book_ref.quote: Examples include common molds, morels, truffles, cup fungi, Neurospora and yeasts

blocks.prompt:
47 The antibiotic penicillin is derived from the fungus:
(Antibiotic penicillin kis fungus se hasil hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Penicillin aik antibiotic hai jo fungus Penicillium se hasil hoti hai (Kingdom Fungi).

book_ref.quote: penicillin, an antibiotic derived from the fungus Penicillium

blocks.prompt:
48 Plants that lack conducting tissues (xylem and phloem) are:
(Woh paude jin mein conducting tissues (xylem aur phloem) nahi hote:)
blocks.explanation: Nonvascular paude ya bryophytes (liverworts, hornworts, mosses) mein xylem aur phloem nahi hote (Kingdom Plantae).

book_ref.quote: Nonvascular plants or bryophytes lack conducting tissues

blocks.prompt:
49 Ferns are examples of:
(Ferns kis ki misaal hain?)
blocks.explanation: Vascular paude seedless (jaise ferns) ya seed plants (jaise conifers aur phoolon wale paude) hote hain (Kingdom Plantae).

book_ref.quote: seedless plants (e.g., ferns) and seed plants

blocks.prompt:
50 Pine, Cedrus and Ginkgo biloba are:
(Pine, Cedrus aur Ginkgo biloba kya hain?)
blocks.explanation: Sago palm, pine, Cedrus aur Ginkgo biloba gymnosperms hain jo seed plants hain (Figure 1.8 ki book correction).

book_ref.quote: These are gymnosperms, which are seed plants

blocks.prompt:
51 Animals obtain food by:
(Janwar khana kaise hasil karte hain?)

options.text: sirf jism ke bahar hazam kar ke
nigal kar jism ke andar hazam kar ke

blocks.explanation: Janwar eukaryotic, multicellular heterotrophs hain jo khana nigal kar jism ke andar hazam karte hain (Kingdom Animalia).

book_ref.quote: They ingest food and digest it within their bodies

blocks.prompt:
52 A common freshwater sponge is:
(Meethe paani ka aam sponge kaun sa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Leucosolenia aur Euplectella samundari sponges hain; Spongilla meethe paani ka aam sponge hai (Phylum Porifera).

book_ref.quote: Spongilla is a common freshwater sponge

blocks.prompt:
53 In sponges, the larger pore through which water leaves the body is the:
(Sponges mein woh bara surakh jis se paani jism se nikalta hai:)
blocks.explanation: Paani bohat se ostia se andar aata hai aur bare osculum se bahar nikalta hai (Phylum Porifera).

book_ref.quote: The larger pore through which water leaves the body is called osculum

blocks.prompt:
54 The layer that lines the spongocoel of a sponge is made of:
(Sponge ke spongocoel ki andar wali teh kin cells ki hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Bahar ki teh pinacocytes ki, darmiyani jelly jaisi mesohyle mein amoeboid cells, aur spongocoel choanocytes (collar cells) se dhaka hai (Phylum Porifera).

book_ref.quote: is made of choanocytes or collar cells

blocks.prompt:
55 Resistant capsules formed by some sponges, from which new sponges arise, are:
(Kuch sponges ke mazboot capsules jin se naye sponge bante hain, kya kehlate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Kuch sponges mazboot gemmules banate hain; munasib mahol mein un se amoeboid cells nikal kar naya sponge banate hain (Phylum Porifera).

book_ref.quote: Some sponges form resistant capsules, called gemmules

blocks.prompt:
56 The special organelle in a cnidocyte that defends the body and captures prey is the:
(Cnidocyte ka khaas organelle jo jism ka difa aur shikar pakarta hai:)
blocks.explanation: Cnidocytes mein nematocysts hote hain jo jism ka difa karte aur shikar pakarte hain (Phylum Cnidaria).

book_ref.quote: A cnidocyte contains a special organelle, called nematocyst

blocks.prompt:
57 In cnidarians, the jelly-like layer between epidermis and gastrodermis is the:
(Cnidarians mein epidermis aur gastrodermis ke darmiyan jelly jaisi teh:)
blocks.explanation: Cnidarians diploblastic hain; epidermis aur gastrodermis ke darmiyan jelly jaisi mesoglea hoti hai jis mein amoeboid cells hain (Phylum Cnidaria).

book_ref.quote: a jelly-like mesoglea is present

blocks.prompt:
58 A digestive system with a single opening for entry of food and removal of undigested matter is called:
(Woh nizam-e-hazam jis mein khana andar aane aur fuzla nikalne ka aik hi surakh ho:)
blocks.explanation: Cnidarians ki gastrovascular cavity ka aik hi surakh hai (munh hi anus ka kaam karta hai): sac-like digestive system (Phylum Cnidaria).

book_ref.quote: is called sac-like digestive system

blocks.prompt:
59 The umbrella-like, free-swimming, sexually reproducing body form of cnidarians is the:
(Cnidarians ki chhatri jaisi, aazad tairne wali, sexual reproduction karne wali shakal:)
blocks.explanation: Polyps nalki jaise, chipke hue aur asexual hain; medusae chhatri jaise, aazad tairne wale aur sexual hain (Phylum Cnidaria).

book_ref.quote: Medusae are umbrella-like and are free-swimming

blocks.prompt:
60 Coral reefs and coral islands are made by the hard exoskeleton of corals, made of:
(Coral reefs aur islands corals ke sakht exoskeleton se bante hain jo bana hota hai:)
blocks.explanation: Corals colonial cnidarians hain jo calcium carbonate ka sakht exoskeleton banate hain; is se coral islands aur reefs bante hain (Phylum Cnidaria).

book_ref.quote: They produce hard exoskeleton of Calcium carbonate

blocks.prompt:
61 In flatworms, each branch of the protonephridia ends in a bulb-like:
(Flatworms mein protonephridia ki har shakh aik bulb jaise cell par khatam hoti hai:)
blocks.explanation: Flatworms ki protonephridia ki shakhen flame cells par khatam hoti hain, jin ke cilia hil kar fluid tubules mein kheenchte hain (Phylum Platyhelminthes).

book_ref.quote: Each branch ends in a bulb-like cell called flame cell

blocks.prompt:
62 In acoelomate flatworms, the space between body wall and organs is filled by:
(Acoelomate flatworms mein body wall aur organs ke darmiyan jagah kis se bhari hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Flatworms acoelomate hain; parenchyma naam ka dheela connective tissue body wall aur organs ke darmiyan jagah bharta hai (Phylum Platyhelminthes).

book_ref.quote: A loose connective tissue called parenchyma fills space between the body wall and body organs

blocks.prompt:
63 Which of the following is a free-living flatworm?
(In mein se kaun sa aazad rehne wala flatworm hai?)
blocks.explanation: Zyada tar flatworms aazad hain, jaise planaria; liver fluke, tapeworm aur blood-fluke endoparasites hain (Phylum Platyhelminthes).

book_ref.quote: Some are endoparasites of humans and other animals

blocks.prompt:
64 Roundworms are called pseudocoelomates because they possess:
(Roundworms ko pseudocoelomate kyun kehte hain?)

options.text: fluid se bhari jhooti body cavity

blocks.explanation: Nematodes mein fluid se bhari jhooti body cavity (pseudocoelom) hoti hai (Phylum Nematoda).

book_ref.quote: they possess a false body cavity called pseudocoelom filled with fluid

blocks.prompt:
65 The seven phyla of pseudocoelomates are grouped as a unit called:
(Pseudocoelomates ke saat phyla ko aik unit ke taur par kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Pseudocoelomates saat phyla mein hain jinhen Aschelminths kehte hain; Nematoda is ka numainda phylum hai (Phylum Nematoda).

book_ref.quote: These phyla are grouped as a unit called Aschelminths

blocks.prompt:
66 In nematodes, the nerve ring around the pharynx is attached to:
(Nematodes mein pharynx ke gird nerve ring kis se judi hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Nematodes mein pharynx ke gird nerve ring chaar lambi nerve cords se judi hoti hai (Phylum Nematoda).

book_ref.quote: There is a nerve ring around the pharynx, which is attached to four longitudinal nerve cords

blocks.prompt:
67 A free-living roundworm found in water and soil is:
(Paani aur mitti mein aazad rehne wala roundworm:)
blocks.explanation: Caenorhabditis elegans aazad hai; ascaris, hookworm, pinworm aur whipworm parasites hain (Phylum Nematoda).

book_ref.quote: Some roundworms are free-living (in water and soil) e.g., Caenorhabditis elegans

blocks.prompt:
68 In molluscs, the epithelial envelope around the visceral mass is the:
(Molluscs mein visceral mass ke gird epithelial ghilaf ko kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Mantle visceral mass ko gherta hai; zyada tar molluscs mein is ki bahari satah calcareous shell banati hai (Phylum Mollusca).

book_ref.quote: They have an epithelial envelope around the visceral mass, called as mantle

blocks.prompt:
69 The rasping tongue-like organ of molluscs (absent in bivalves) is the:
(Molluscs ka ragarne wala zaban jaisa organ (bivalves mein nahi) kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Bivalvia ke ilawa tamam molluscs mein ragarne wala zaban jaisa organ radula hota hai (Phylum Mollusca).

book_ref.quote: All molluscs (except bivalvia) have is a rasping tongue-like organ, called radula

blocks.prompt:
70 Which group of molluscs does NOT have an open type circulatory system?
(Molluscs ke kis group mein open circulatory system nahi hota?)
blocks.explanation: Cephalopods ke ilawa tamam molluscs mein open type circulatory system hai (Phylum Mollusca).

book_ref.quote: All of them (except cephalopods) have open type blood circulatory system

blocks.prompt:
71 The heart of molluscs consists of:
(Molluscs ka dil kis par mushtamil hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Molluscs ke dil mein aik ventricle aur do auricles hote hain (Phylum Mollusca).

book_ref.quote: Their heart consists of a single ventricle and two auricles

blocks.prompt:
72 Segmentation in which each segment has its own circulatory, excretory and neural elements is called:
(Woh segmentation jis mein har segment ke apne circulatory, excretory aur neural hisse hon:)
blocks.explanation: Annelids mein har segment ke apne circulatory, excretory aur neural hisse hain: metameric segmentation (Phylum Annelida).

book_ref.quote: This type of segmentation in body is called metameric segmentation

blocks.prompt:
73 Chitinous bristles in the ventral wall of each segment of annelids are called:
(Annelids ke har segment ki ventral wall mein chitin ke baal kya kehlate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Setae har segment ki ventral wall mein chitin ke baal hain; leeches mein nahi hote (Phylum Annelida).

book_ref.quote: Setae are chitinous bristles in the ventral wall of each segment

blocks.prompt:
74 The specialized pulsating blood vessels of annelids are called:
(Annelids ki khaas dhadakne wali blood vessels ko kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Annelids ka closed circulatory system hai jis mein dhadakti vessels pseudohearts kehlati hain (Phylum Annelida).

book_ref.quote: They have specialized pulsating blood vessels (pseudohearts)

blocks.prompt:
75 The excretory organs of annelids, one pair in each segment, are:
(Annelids ke excretory organs, har segment mein aik jora, kya hain?)
blocks.explanation: Annelids ka excretory system cilia wale, keep jaise metanephridia par mushtamil hai, har segment mein aik jora (Phylum Annelida).

book_ref.quote: Each segment has one pair of metanephridia

blocks.prompt:
76 Which annelid is unisexual?
(Kaun sa annelid unisexual hai?)
blocks.explanation: Zyada tar annelids hermaphrodite hain (earthworm, leech); kuch unisexual hain (nereis) (Phylum Annelida).

book_ref.quote: some are unisexual (e.g., nereis)

blocks.prompt:
77 In arthropods, fused segments forming specialized body regions such as head, thorax and abdomen are called:
(Arthropods mein jude hue segments se bane khaas hisse (head, thorax, abdomen) kya kehlate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Arthropods ke kuch segments jud kar tagmata banate hain: head, thorax aur abdomen (Phylum Arthropoda).

book_ref.quote: Some segments are fused to form specialized body regions called tagmata

blocks.prompt:
78 Periodic shedding of the exoskeleton in young arthropods is called:
(Kam umar arthropods mein exoskeleton ka waqtan fawaqtan utarna kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Kam umar arthropods exoskeleton utarte, tezi se barhte aur naya banate hain: ecdysis ya molting (Phylum Arthropoda).

book_ref.quote: This process is called ecdysis or molting

blocks.prompt:
79 The colourless blood of arthropods, without haemoglobin, is called:
(Arthropods ka be-rang khoon jis mein haemoglobin nahi, kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Arthropods ka khoon be-rang hai, haemoglobin ke baghair, aur haemolymph kehlata hai; yeh hemocoel mein behta hai (Phylum Arthropoda).

book_ref.quote: is without haemoglobin and is known as haemolymph

blocks.prompt:
80 The excretory organs of arthropods, attached at the junction of midgut and hindgut, are:
(Arthropods ke excretory organs jo midgut aur hindgut ke milap par lage hain:)
blocks.explanation: Arthropods Malpighian tubules se kharij karte hain jo midgut-hindgut ke milap par hain; fuzla solid uric acid crystals ki shakal mein nikalta hai (Phylum Arthropoda).

book_ref.quote: Their excretory system comprises of Malpighian tubules

blocks.prompt:
81 In terrestrial arthropods, the main tracheal tubes open to the outside through:
(Khushki ke arthropods mein main tracheal tubes bahar kin surakhon se khulti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Zyada tar arthropods tracheae se saans lete hain jin ki main tubes spiracles se khulti hain; paani wale arthropods gills istemal karte hain (Phylum Arthropoda).

book_ref.quote: Main tracheal tubes open out through openings called spiracles

blocks.prompt:
82 About how many species of arthropods are known (about two-thirds of all named species)?
(Arthropods ki taqreeban kitni species maloom hain (tamam naam shuda species ka do tihai)?)
blocks.explanation: Arthropods sab se kamyab invertebrates hain: taqreeban 900,000 species, tamam naam shuda species ka do tihai (Phylum Arthropoda).

book_ref.quote: Arthropods are the most successful of all invertebrates

blocks.prompt:
83 The ring canal of echinoderms opens outside through a sieve-like plate called the:
(Echinoderms ki ring canal bahar aik chhalni jaisi plate se khulti hai jise kehte hain:)
blocks.explanation: Munh ke gird ring canal chhalni jaisi madreporite se bahar khulti hai (Phylum Echinodermata).

book_ref.quote: It opens outside through a sieve-like plate, called madreporite

blocks.prompt:
84 The calcareous endoskeletal plates of echinoderms are called:
(Echinoderms ke calcareous endoskeleton ki plates kya kehlati hain?)
blocks.explanation: Echinoderms ka calcareous endoskeleton mesoderm se bani plates (ossicles) ka hai jo jild par kaante bhi banati hain (Phylum Echinodermata).

book_ref.quote: They possess a calcareous endoskeleton in the form of plates called ossicles

blocks.prompt:
85 Symmetry of the larva and adult of echinoderms is respectively:
(Echinoderms ke larva aur adult ki symmetry tarteeb se kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Echinoderms ke larva bilateral hain magar adult radial (paanch hisson wali) symmetry dikhate hain (Phylum Echinodermata).

book_ref.quote: Their larvae are bilateral symmetrical but the adults show radial symmetry

blocks.prompt:
86 A star-shaped echinoderm with long arms is the:
(Lambe baazuon wala sitara numa echinoderm:)
blocks.explanation: Sea star ke chhote baazu, brittle star ke lambe baazu; sea urchin gol aur sea cucumber lamba hai (Phylum Echinodermata).

book_ref.quote: some are star-shaped with long arms (e.g., brittle star)

blocks.prompt:
87 The rod-like, semi-rigid body of vacuolated cells between gut and dorsal nerve cord of chordates is the:
(Chordates mein gut aur dorsal nerve cord ke darmiyan vacuole wale cells ki semi-rigid rod:)
blocks.explanation: Notochord vacuole wale cells ki semi-rigid rod hai jo gut aur dorsal nerve cord ke darmiyan hai (Phylum Chordata).

book_ref.quote: It is a rod-like semi rigid body of vacuolated cells

blocks.prompt:
88 Amphioxus belongs to the subphylum:
(Amphioxus kis subphylum mein hai?)
blocks.explanation: Cephalochordata mein notochord saari zindagi rehta hai; Amphioxus aam cephalochordate hai (Phylum Chordata).

book_ref.quote: Amphioxus is a common cephalochordate

blocks.prompt:
89 In which chordates are the notochord and nerve cord present only in the free-swimming larva?
(Kin chordates mein notochord aur nerve cord sirf aazad tairne wale larva mein hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Urochordata (jaise sea squirts) mein notochord aur nerve cord sirf aazad tairne wale larva mein hote hain (Phylum Chordata).

book_ref.quote: notochord and nerve cord are present only in their free-swimming larvae

blocks.prompt:
90 In chordates, the tubular nerve cord expands anteriorly as the:
(Chordates mein tubular nerve cord aage ki taraf phail kar kya banti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Tubular nerve cord notochord ke oopar chalti hai aur aage phail kar dimagh banti hai (Phylum Chordata).

book_ref.quote: It expands anteriorly as a brain

blocks.prompt:
91 How many classes of vertebrates are placed in group Tetrapoda?
(Group Tetrapoda mein vertebrates ki kitni classes hain?)
blocks.explanation: Group Pisces mein 3 classes (bina limbs) aur group Tetrapoda mein 4 classes (Amphibia, Reptilia, Aves, Mammalia) chaar limbs wali hain (1.5).

book_ref.quote: Group Tetrapoda: It includes 4 classes

blocks.prompt:
92 Lampreys and hagfish are:
(Lampreys aur hagfish kya hain?)
blocks.explanation: Cyclostomata jabron ke baghair machhliyan hain jaise lampreys aur hagfish; jism eel jaisa aur scales ke baghair (Class Cyclostomata).

book_ref.quote: These are jawless fishes. Lampreys and hagfish are common examples

blocks.prompt:
93 The placoid (tooth-like) scales of cartilaginous fishes are called:
(Cartilaginous machhliyon ke placoid (daant jaise) scales kya kehlate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Chondrichthyes ka jism placoid (daant jaise) scales se dhaka hai jinhen denticles kehte hain (Class Chondrichthyes).

book_ref.quote: Their body is covered by placoid (tooth-like) scales, called denticles

blocks.prompt:
94 Which of the following is absent in sharks and rays?
(Sharks aur rays mein kya nahi hota?)
blocks.explanation: Chondrichthyes mein jabre, paired fins aur spiracles hain magar swim bladder nahi (Class Chondrichthyes).

book_ref.quote: They do not have swim bladder

blocks.prompt:
95 In bony fishes, the protective bony flap over the gills is the:
(Bony machhliyon mein gills ko dhaanpne wala haddi ka parda:)
blocks.explanation: Bony machhliyon ke gills ke chaar joray hain jinhen haddi ka parda operculum bachata hai (Class Osteichthyes).

book_ref.quote: A protective bony flap, operculum, protects the gills

blocks.prompt:
96 The number of pairs of cranial nerves in bony fishes is:
(Bony machhliyon mein cranial nerves ke kitne joray hain?)
blocks.explanation: Bony machhliyon ka nervous system acha bana hai jis mein cranial nerves ke das joray hain (Class Osteichthyes).

book_ref.quote: there are ten pairs of cranial nerves

blocks.prompt:
97 The swim bladder of bony fishes helps in:
(Bony machhliyon ka swim bladder kis cheez mein madad karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Bony machhliyon ka swim bladder paani mein tairte rehne (buoyancy) mein madad karta hai (Class Osteichthyes).

book_ref.quote: They also have a swim bladder that helps in buoyancy

blocks.prompt:
98 Which of these is a marine bony fish?
(In mein se kaun si samundari bony machhli hai?)
blocks.explanation: Meethe paani ki bony machhliyan rohu, trout, Katla, catfish; samundari seahorse, flying fish, angler fish (Class Osteichthyes).

book_ref.quote: The marine bony fishes include seahorse, flying fish and angler fish

blocks.prompt:
99 The heart of amphibians has:
(Amphibians ke dil mein kya hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Amphibians ka dil double-circuit aur teen khanon wala hai: do atria aur aik ventricle (Class Amphibia).

book_ref.quote: It is three-chambered, with two atria and one ventricle

blocks.prompt:
100 Leg-less amphibians are:
(Bina taangon wale amphibians:)
blocks.explanation: Salamanders, newts aur mud puppies dum wale; frogs aur toads be-dum; caecilians bina taangon ke (Class Amphibia).

book_ref.quote: caecilians are leg-less amphibians

blocks.prompt:
101 Amphibians hibernate in winter because they are:
(Amphibians sardi mein hibernate kyun karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Amphibians ectotherms hain aur jism ka temperature yaksan nahi rakh sakte, is liye poikilothermic hain aur sardi mein hibernate karte hain (Class Amphibia).

book_ref.quote: So, they are poikilothermic animals and hibernate in winter

blocks.prompt:
102 In reptiles, the first two cervical vertebrae that allow more movement of the head are:
(Reptiles mein pehli do cervical vertebrae jo sar ko zyada harkat deti hain:)
blocks.explanation: Reptiles mein atlas aur axis (pehli do cervical vertebrae) sar ko zyada harkat deti hain (Class Reptilia).

book_ref.quote: In reptiles, first two cervical vertebrae (atlas and axis) allow more movements of head

blocks.prompt:
103 In the amniotic egg, the primary food supply for the embryo is the:
(Amniotic egg mein embryo ki bunyadi ghiza kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Amniotic eggs mein yolk ki bari miqdaar hai jo bunyadi ghiza hai; albumin izafi ghiza aur paani deta hai (Class Reptilia).

book_ref.quote: The amniotic eggs also contain a large amount of yolk

blocks.prompt:
104 In the reptilian heart, the ventricle is:
(Reptiles ke dil mein ventricle kaisa hota hai?)

options.text: left aur right mein adhoora taqseem
machhliyon ki tarah aik aur ghair taqseem

blocks.explanation: Reptiles mein ventricle left aur right mein adhoora taqseem hota hai (Class Reptilia).

book_ref.quote: In their heart, ventricle is incompletely partitioned

blocks.prompt:
105 The organ of voice in birds, at the lower end of the trachea, is the:
(Parindon mein trachea ke nichle sire par awaz ka organ:)
blocks.explanation: Parindon mein awaz ka organ syrinx trachea ke nichle sire par hai (Class Aves).

book_ref.quote: The organ of voice, called syrinx

blocks.prompt:
106 The region of a bird's stomach with muscular walls that crushes food is the:
(Parinde ke maide ka woh hissa jis ki muscular deewaren khana peesti hain:)
blocks.explanation: Crop (oesophagus ki thaili) khana jama karta hai; gizzard, maide ka muscular hissa, khana peesta hai (Class Aves).

book_ref.quote: A region of stomach, called gizzard, has muscular walls to crush food

blocks.prompt:
107 The lungs of birds are made of small air tubes called:
(Parindon ke phephre kin chhoti hawai nalkiyon se bane hain?)
blocks.explanation: Parindon ke phephre, jo air sacs se jude hain, parabronchi naam ki chhoti hawai nalkiyon se bane hain (Class Aves).

book_ref.quote: The air sacs connect to lungs, which are made of small air tubes called parabronchi

blocks.prompt:
108 The shell of a bird's egg is:
(Parinde ke ande ka chhilka kaisa hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Parinde ke ande ka chhilka sakht aur calcareous hai (zyada tar calcium carbonate); naram leathery chhilka bohat se reptiles ke andon mein hai (book correction, Class Aves).

book_ref.quote: A bird’s egg has a hard, calcareous shell made mainly of calcium carbonate

blocks.prompt:
109 Which of the following is a running (flightless) bird?
(In mein se kaun sa daurne wala (na urne wala) parinda hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ostrich, kiwi, rhea, cassowary aur emu ne udne ki salahiyat kho di; pigeon, parrot, crow, eagle, robin urte hain (Class Aves).

book_ref.quote: running birds e.g., ostrich, kiwi, rhea, cassowary, and emu

blocks.prompt:
110 Which bones form the chain in the mammalian middle ear?
(Mammals ke middle ear mein kaun si haddiyon ki zanjeer hai?)
blocks.explanation: Mammals ke middle ear mein teen haddiyon ki zanjeer hai: incus, malleus aur stapes (Class Mammalia).

book_ref.quote: The middle ear has a chain of three bones

blocks.prompt:
111 Mammalian glands that release watery secretions used in evaporative cooling are the:
(Mammals ke woh glands jo bukharati thandak ke liye paani jaisi ratoobat chhorte hain:)
blocks.explanation: Sebaceous glands tel nikalte hain; sudoriferous (paseene ke) glands bukharati thandak ke liye paani jaisi ratoobat nikalte hain (Class Mammalia).

book_ref.quote: Sudoriferous (sweat) glands release watery secretions used in evaporative cooling

blocks.prompt:
112 Egg-laying mammals found in Australia include:
(Australia mein milne wale ande dene wale mammals:)
blocks.explanation: Duckbill platypus aur echidna (spiny anteater) Australia ke ande dene wale mammals hain (Class Mammalia).

book_ref.quote: These mammals are found in Australia e.g., Duckbill platypus and echidna

blocks.prompt:
113 Marsupials such as the kangaroo give birth to immature young ones; they are:
(Kangaroo jaise marsupials adhoore bachche paida karte hain; woh hain:)
blocks.explanation: Marsupials viviparous hain: embryo thori der ke (yolk-sac) placenta se ghiza leta hai, zinda paida hota hai aur pouch mein mukammal hota hai (book correction, Class Mammalia).

book_ref.quote: Marsupials are viviparous

blocks.prompt:
114 In placental mammals, the foetus is nourished and its wastes removed through the:
(Placental mammals mein foetus ko ghiza aur fuzle ka ikhraj kis ke zariye hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Maa ki uterus wall aur foetus ke darmiyan placenta banta hai; is se foetus ko ghiza milti aur fuzla nikalta hai (Class Mammalia).

book_ref.quote: a structure called placenta, is formed between mother

blocks.prompt:
115 Viruses are not considered organisms because they are:
(Viruses ko organisms kyun nahi mana jata?)
blocks.explanation: Viruses acellular hain (cells se nahi bane), teenon domains ki khususiyaat nahi rakhte aur kisi domain ya kingdom mein nahi rakhe jate (1.6).

book_ref.quote: Viruses are not considered organisms because they are acellular

blocks.prompt:
116 Viroids are composed of:
(Viroids kis cheez se bane hain?)
blocks.explanation: Prions sirf protein se bane hain; viroids sirf gol (circular) RNA se (1.6).

book_ref.quote: Viroids are composed of circular RNA only

blocks.prompt:
117 Mad cow disease (BSE) in cattle is caused by:
(Gaaye ki mad cow disease (BSE) kis se hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Prions janwaron aur insanon mein bimariyan karte hain (scrapie, BSE, Creutzfeldt-Jakob disease); viroids paudon mein (book correction, 1.6).

book_ref.quote: Prions cause infectious diseases in animals and humans, not plants

blocks.prompt:
118 The guidelines for classification of viruses are established by:
(Viruses ki classification ke usool kaun tay karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Viruses ki classification International Committee on Taxonomy of Viruses (ICTV) ke usoolon par hai (1.6).

book_ref.quote: International Committee on Taxonomy of Viruses

blocks.prompt:
119 Sulfolobus spindle-shaped virus infects:
(Sulfolobus spindle-shaped virus kis ko infect karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Host range ke lehaz se Sulfolobus spindle-shaped virus archaea virus hai (1.6).

book_ref.quote: Archaea Viruses: Infect archaea

blocks.prompt:
120 T4 phage and Lambda phage are examples of:
(T4 phage aur Lambda phage kis ki misaalen hain?)
blocks.explanation: Bacteriophages bacteria ko infect karte hain, jaise T4 phage aur Lambda phage (1.6).

book_ref.quote: Bacteriophages: Infect bacteria

blocks.prompt:
121 Adenoviruses and herpesviruses are classified by morphology as:
(Shakal ke lehaz se adenoviruses aur herpesviruses kya hain?)
blocks.explanation: Icosahedral viruses ka capsid symmetrical icosahedral shakal ka hai, jaise adenoviruses, herpesviruses (1.6).

book_ref.quote: These have a capsid with a symmetrical icosahedral shape

blocks.prompt:
122 The outer lipid envelope of enveloped viruses is derived from the:
(Enveloped viruses ka bahari lipid ghilaf kahan se aata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Enveloped viruses (jaise influenza, HIV) ka bahari lipid ghilaf host cell ki membrane se banta hai (1.6).

book_ref.quote: These have an outer lipid envelope derived from the host cell membrane

blocks.prompt:
123 Poliovirus is an example of:
(Poliovirus kis ki misaal hai?)
blocks.explanation: Non-enveloped (naked) viruses mein lipid ghilaf nahi, sirf capsid hai, jaise poliovirus, adenovirus (1.6).

book_ref.quote: Non-enveloped (Naked) Viruses

blocks.prompt:
124 Rotaviruses, which cause gastroenteritis, have:
(Rotaviruses, jo gastroenteritis karte hain, mein kya hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Rotaviruses dsRNA viruses hain jo gastroenteritis karte hain (1.6).

book_ref.quote: Rotaviruses (cause gastroenteritis)

blocks.prompt:
125 Parvoviruses are:
(Parvoviruses kya hain?)
blocks.explanation: Parvoviruses ssDNA viruses hain (gastroenteritis karte hain) (1.6).

book_ref.quote: Parvoviruses (cause gastroenteritis)

blocks.prompt:
126 Rabies virus and Ebola virus are:
(Rabies virus aur Ebola virus kya hain?)
blocks.explanation: Negative-sense RNA viruses (rabies, Ebola) ka genome pehle viral RNA polymerase se mRNA mein badalta hai (1.6).

book_ref.quote: The RNA genome is transcribed into mRNA by a viral RNA polymerase before translation

blocks.prompt:
127 Reverse transcribing viruses replicate through a DNA intermediate using the enzyme:
(Reverse transcribing viruses DNA intermediate ke zariye kis enzyme se nakal banate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Reverse transcribing viruses (HIV, hepatitis B virus) reverse transcriptase se DNA intermediate bana kar nakal banate hain (1.6).

book_ref.quote: These viruses replicate through a DNA intermediate using the enzyme reverse transcriptase

blocks.prompt:
128 Hepatitis B virus is a reverse transcribing virus with:
(Hepatitis B virus aik reverse transcribing virus hai jis mein hota hai:)
blocks.explanation: Reverse transcribing viruses mein retroviruses (HIV) ka RNA genome aur hepadnaviruses (hepatitis B virus) ka DNA genome hai (1.6).

book_ref.quote: DNA genome: Hepadnaviruses like Hepatitis B virus

blocks.prompt:
129 The role or function of an organism or species within an ecosystem is its:
(Ecosystem mein kisi organism ya species ka kirdar ya kaam kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Niche ecosystem mein organism ka kirdar hai, jis mein us ka habitat, rishte aur energy flow mein hissa shamil hain (1.7).

book_ref.quote: A niche refers to the role or function of an organism or species within an ecosystem

blocks.prompt:
130 Genetic diversity is crucial for species because it:
(Genetic diversity species ke liye kyun zaroori hai?)

options.text: mahol ki tabdeeli ke mutabiq dhalne mein madad deti hai
un ki tadaad muqarrar kar deti hai

blocks.explanation: Genetic diversity mutabiqat aur baqa ke liye zaroori hai; is se species mahol ki tabdeeliyon ka muqabla kar sakti hain (Assessment Levels).

book_ref.quote: This genetic diversity is crucial for the adaptability and survival of species

blocks.prompt:
131 Random sampling minimizes bias because:
(Random sampling bias (janibdari) kyun kam karti hai?)

options.text: sirf nayab species gini jati hain
sirf aik quadrat istemal hota hai
sab se bare janwar chune jate hain
ilaqe ke har hisse ko barabar mauqa milta hai

blocks.explanation: Random sampling mein tehqeeq ke ilaqe ke har hisse ko barabar mauqa milta hai, is liye tasweer zyada durust hoti hai (Random Sampling).

book_ref.quote: every part of the study area has an equal chance of being sampled

blocks.prompt:
132 Quadrat sampling is particularly useful for studying:
(Quadrat sampling khaas taur par kis ke mutaale ke liye mufeed hai?)

options.text: paudon ki aabaadi ya sessile organisms

blocks.explanation: Quadrat sampling (grid ke random squares) paudon aur aik jagah jame organisms ke liye mufeed hai (Methods to Assess Distribution).

book_ref.quote: This method is particularly useful for studying plant populations or sessile organisms

blocks.prompt:
133 Tracking the distribution of bird species across a large wetland is best done by:
(Bari wetland mein parindon ki species ki taqseem dekhne ka behtareen tareeqa:)
blocks.explanation: Aerial surveys bare ilaqon par aircraft ya drones istemal karte hain, jaise bari wetland mein parinde (Methods to Assess Distribution).

book_ref.quote: Aerial surveys use aircraft or drones to observe

blocks.prompt:
134 In a coastal zone, a line laid from the high tide line to the low tide line to record intertidal organisms is a:
(Sahil par high tide line se low tide line tak intertidal organisms record karne ke liye bichhai gayi line:)
blocks.explanation: Transect sampling mein line ya patti bichha kar baqaida faslon par species record ki jati hain, jaise high se low tide line (Methods to Assess Distribution).

book_ref.quote: a transect can be laid from the high tide line to the low tide line

blocks.prompt:
135 Observing and recording the number of individuals from a fixed point over a specified period is called:
(Aik muqarrar jagah se muqarrar waqt tak afraad ki tadaad record karna kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Point counts mein aik jagah se muqarrar waqt tak afraad gine jate hain; parindon aur harkat karne wale janwaron ke liye (Methods to Assess Abundance).

book_ref.quote: This method is commonly used for birds and other mobile animals

blocks.prompt:
136 Capturing, marking, releasing and later recapturing individuals to estimate population size is called:
(Afraad ko pakar kar, nishan laga kar, chhor kar aur baad mein dobara pakar kar aabaadi ka andaza lagana:)
blocks.explanation: Mark-recapture un janwaron ke liye mufeed hai jinhen seedha ginna mushkil ho (Methods to Assess Abundance).

book_ref.quote: This method is useful for animals that are difficult to count directly

blocks.prompt:
137 Assessing abundance and distribution of species in large-scale or inaccessible areas using satellite imagery is:
(Bare ya na-qabil-e-rasai ilaqon mein satellite tasweeron se species ka andaza lagana:)
blocks.explanation: Remote sensing satellite ya drone tasweeren istemal karti hai, khaas taur par bare ya na-qabil-e-rasai ilaqon ke liye (Methods to Assess Abundance).

book_ref.quote: Remote sensing uses satellite or drone imagery

blocks.prompt:
138 The biologist who emphasized reproductive isolation as the key criterion for species was:
(Kis biologist ne species ke liye reproductive isolation ko bunyadi kasauti qaraar diya?)
blocks.explanation: Ernst Mayr ne reproductive isolation par zor diya; species aapas mein nasl barhane wali qudrati aabaadiyon ke groups hain (1.8).

book_ref.quote: German-American biologist, Ernst Mayr, emphasized reproductive isolation as the key criterion

blocks.prompt:
139 Organisms that appear similar but are genetically distinct are called:
(Woh organisms jo dekhne mein aik jaise magar genetically alag hon:)
blocks.explanation: Cryptic species dekhne mein aik jaisi magar genetically alag hain, is liye physical traits se pehchan mushkil hai (1.8).

book_ref.quote: cryptic species - organisms that appear similar but are genetically distinct

blocks.prompt:
140 The evolutionary process by which new species arise from a common ancestor is:
(Woh evolutionary amal jis se mushtarka jadd se nayi species banti hain:)
blocks.explanation: Speciation woh amal hai jis se mushtarka jadd se nayi species banti hain, genetic tabdeeliyon se reproductive isolation ke zariye (Speciation).

book_ref.quote: Speciation is the evolutionary process by which new species arise from a common ancestor

blocks.prompt:
141 The speciation of Darwin's finches on the Galapagos Islands is an example of:
(Galapagos Islands par Darwin ki finches ki speciation kis ki misaal hai?)
blocks.explanation: Galapagos Islands par Darwin ki finches allopatric speciation ki misaal hain (Allopatric Speciation).

book_ref.quote: speciation observed in Darwin

blocks.prompt:
142 Speciation in a small, isolated population at the edge of a larger population is:
(Bari aabaadi ke kinare par chhoti, alag aabaadi mein speciation:)
blocks.explanation: Peripatric speciation mein bari aabaadi ke kinare par chhoti alag aabaadi tezi se badalti hai, jaise chhoti bani aabaadi se island species (Peripatric).

book_ref.quote: It involves a small, isolated population at the edge of a larger population

blocks.prompt:
143 The grass Anthoxanthum odoratum, adapted to different soil conditions along a gradient, illustrates:
(Ghaas Anthoxanthum odoratum jo gradient par mukhtalif mitti ke mutabiq dhali, kis ki misaal hai?)
blocks.explanation: Parapatric speciation mein saath wali aabaadiyan gradient par mukhtalif mahol mein hoti hain aur gene flow kam hota hai, jaise Anthoxanthum odoratum (Parapatric).

book_ref.quote: which exhibits different adaptations to varying soil conditions across a gradient

blocks.prompt:
144 A condition in which an organism has multiple sets of chromosomes, causing immediate reproductive isolation in some plants, is:
(Woh halat jis mein organism mein chromosomes ke kai sets hon aur kuch paudon mein foran reproductive isolation ho:)
blocks.explanation: Sympatric speciation aksar polyploidy (chromosomes ke kai sets) se hoti hai jo kuch paudon mein foran reproductive isolation deti hai (Sympatric).

book_ref.quote: where an organism has multiple sets of chromosomes

blocks.prompt:
145 Speciation within the same geographical area without physical barriers is:
(Aik hi jughrafiyai ilaqe mein, baghair physical rukawat ke, speciation:)
blocks.explanation: Sympatric speciation mein nayi species aik hi ilaqe mein baghair physical rukawat ke banti hain, polyploidy ya niche differentiation se (Sympatric).

book_ref.quote: new species arise within the same geographical area without physical barriers
